This case is registered on the basis of charge sheet submitted by ACP Malleshwaram police station against the accused persons for the offences punishable under Section 498A, 304(B), 109 R/w.34 of IPC sec.4 of D.P.Act and sec.3(2)(v) of SC/ST (POA) Act 1989.

2. The case of the prosecution is that accused No.1 loved deceased Smt.Rani @ Ramanamma 6 years back and married her and had 2 female children, S.C.694/2016 and was residing in No.24, Ist floor,
Ist A cross, 3 rd Main road, Preethinagar, Laggere, later the the accused No.1 on the instigation of accused Nos.2 and 3 has demanded the CW1 to bring dowry, on 22.2.2016 at 4.00 p.m. accused No.1 with the instigation of accused Nos.2 and 3 assaulted deceased Rani with hands, and pressed her neck and committed murder.

The victim lodged complaint before the jurisdictional Rajgopal Nagar Police.
On the basis of complaint, the investigating officer on conclusion has filed charge sheet.
3. On service of the summons, the accused persons appeared before this Court and they got enlarged on bail.
The charge sheet copies were furnished to the accused persons as contemplated under Section 207 of Cr.P.C. Heard before the charge, by my predeccesor in office.

304(B), 109 R/w.34 of IPC and sec.3(2)(v) of SC/ST (POA) Act 1989, read over and explained to the accused persons in vernacular language and they pleaded not guilty , claim to be tried.
4. At trial, the prosecution got examined PWs-1 to 18 and got exhibited Exs.P.1 and 19 and M.Os.1 to 5 and closed its side.
